unitRules.name: Unbridled Revel
unitRules.text: The Frozen Stars' bloodiest performers do not dodge: they hurl themselves at the foe and keep killing until the stage is clear. In the Fight Sub-Phase of an Assault Phase in which this Unit made a successful Charge, its Models modify their Attacks Characteristic by +1. However, this Unit may never have the Disengage aftermath option selected for it through The Great Dance unless it lost the Combat.

options.text: The Lead Reveller may have its Harlequin's Embrace exchanged for an item from the Lead Player Weapons List.
For every 5 Models in this Unit, up to two Models may have their Shuriken Pistol exchanged for an item from the Harlequin Pistols List.

units.note: Frozen Stars only. Written for this list: the masque of the most violent tales fields a troupe that has given up dodging.
units.name: Revel Troupe

unitRules.name: Dirge of the Fall
unitRules.text: The chorus of the Midnight Sorrow sings the fall of a race, and those who hear it lose heart. Enemy Units with at least one Model within 12" of this Unit modify the Leadership Characteristic of their Models by -1. In addition, an enemy Unit with the Routed Tactical Status that has any Models within 12" of this Unit may not remove that Status.

units.note: Midnight Sorrow only. Written for this list: the chorus that performs the Fall of the Aeldari.
units.name: Tragedians

unitRules.name: Figments
unitRules.text: Phantasms are illusions woven by the Veiled Path's Shadowseers, players who are not there. Models in this Unit may not make attacks of any kind, may not Control or Contest Objectives, may not be joined by other Models, and are not counted when an enemy scores Victory Points for destroying Units. At the start of its Controlling Player's turn, if this Unit has fewer Models than it began the battle with and has at least one Model within 24" of a friendly Model with the Psyker Trait, return one Model that was Removed as a Casualty to the Unit, placed in Unit Coherency and more than 1" from all enemy Models.

unitRules.name: Lure of the Veil
unitRules.text: When an enemy Unit declares a Shooting Attack or a Charge targeting a friendly Unit with the Veiled Path Trait (other than this Unit) that has any Models within 6" of this Unit, it must make an Intelligence Check. If the Check is failed, the Shooting Attack or Charge must target this Unit instead if this Unit is a legal target; otherwise it continues as declared. An enemy Unit makes at most one such Check in each Phase.

units.note: Veiled Path only. Written for this list: decoys projected by the masque of deception.
units.name: Phantasms

unitRules.name: Silence the Voice
unitRules.text: The Unspeaking kill those who give orders first, and a unit that loses its voice forgets what it was doing. If an attack made by a Model in this Unit destroys an enemy Model with the Command, Champion or Sergeant Sub-Type, that Model's Unit gains the Stunned Tactical Status.

units.note: Silent Shroud only. Written for this list: the elite mimes of the masque that never speaks.
units.name: The Unspeaking

unitRules.name: Laughing Pass
unitRules.text: The Soaring Spite fly low enough to be heard laughing. Once in each of its Controlling Player's Movement Phases, after this Model moves, its Controlling Player may select one enemy Unit that it moved over during that move. That Unit must make a Cool Check; if the Check is failed, it gains the Pinned Tactical Status.

units.note: Soaring Spite only. Written for this list: a webway fighter, the army's only Flyer.
units.name: Starshrike

unitRules.name: Already Dead
unitRules.text: Each of these players has died once on the stage of the Dreaming Shadow and returned to finish the tale. Models in this Unit have the Eternal Warrior (1) Special Rule, which is already included in their Special Rules, and are not affected by the Fear (X) Special Rule.

options.text: Any Model in this Unit may have its Harlequin's Blade exchanged for an item from the Harlequin Melee Weapons List.
For every 5 Models in this Unit, one Model may have its Harlequin's Blade exchanged for a Harlequin's Caress for +10 points.
For every 5 Models in this Unit, up to two Models may have their Shuriken Pistol exchanged for an item from the Harlequin Pistols List.
The Lead Player may have its Harlequin's Blade exchanged for an item from the Lead Player Weapons List.

units.note: Dreaming Shadow only. Written for this list: players of the masque haunted by the dead, who have died once already.
units.name: Deathmask Players

unitRules.name: Wraith-construct
unitRules.text: A wraithbone shell animated by the spirit of a dead Aeldari, painted in the colours of the masque it marches with. A Model with this Special Rule is not affected by the Fear (X) Special Rule and never gains the Pinned or Routed Tactical Status.

unitRules.name: Wraithsight
unitRules.text: The spirit within sees the battlefield only dimly without a psyker to guide it. At the start of its Controlling Player's turn, unless a Model with this Special Rule is within 12" of a friendly Model with the Psyker Trait (such as a Shadowseer), roll a Dice. On a result of 1, it gains the Stunned Tactical Status.

options.text: Any Model in this Unit may have its Ghostswords exchanged for a Ghostaxe for free.
Any Model in this Unit may have a Forceshield for +10 points per Model.

units.note: Wraithblades in Harlequin death masks: the spirits of dead players, still dancing. Written for this list; they follow on from the Rogue Trader dreadnought that became the Wraithlord.
units.name: Wraith-dancers

unitRules.name: Thrown Voice
unitRules.text: The Ventriloquist speaks in the voices of the enemy's own officers. Once in each enemy Player Turn, when an enemy Unit with at least one Model within 18" of the Ventriloquist declares a Reaction or Advanced Reaction, the Ventriloquist's Controlling Player may force that Unit to make an Intelligence Check. If the Check is failed, the Reaction is cancelled, but the Reaction Point spent on it is not returned.

unitRules.name: Come Closer
unitRules.text: Once in each of its Controlling Player's turns, at the start of the Movement Phase, the Ventriloquist may call to one enemy Unit with at least one Model within 12" of it. That Unit must make a Willpower Check. If the Check is failed, its Controlling Player must move it D6" directly towards the Ventriloquist, following the normal Rules for Movement but stopping 1" away from any Model.

unitRules.name: Puppet Strings
unitRules.text: The Mannequin is a wraithbone puppet that moves only as the Ventriloquist's wires move it. If the Ventriloquist is Removed as a Casualty, the Mannequin is Removed as a Casualty at the same time. The Mannequin is not affected by the Fear (X) Special Rule.

units.note: Written for this list: a puppeteer psyker and the wraithbone mannequin that fights for him.
units.name: The Ventriloquist

unitRules.name: Wraith-construct
unitRules.text: A wraithbone shell animated by the spirit of a dead Aeldari, painted in the colours of the masque it marches with. A Model with this Special Rule is not affected by the Fear (X) Special Rule and never gains the Pinned or Routed Tactical Status.

unitRules.name: Wraithsight
unitRules.text: The spirit within sees the battlefield only dimly without a psyker to guide it. At the start of its Controlling Player's turn, unless a Model with this Special Rule is within 12" of a friendly Model with the Psyker Trait (such as a Shadowseer), roll a Dice. On a result of 1, it gains the Stunned Tactical Status.

options.text: May exchange its Ghostglaive and Scattershield for one of the following:
May take one or two Shoulder mounted Shuriken Cannons for +10 points each.

units.note: A wraithknight in motley, the largest of the wraith-constructs that march with the masques. Written for this list.
units.name: Harlequin Wraithknight

unitRules.name: The Final Act
unitRules.text: The Laughing God never walks onto the stage: in the last act he takes the place of the player who plays him. This Model is not deployed at the start of the battle. From the second battle turn onwards, at the start of its Controlling Player's Movement Phase, its Controlling Player may select one friendly Great Harlequin or Troupe Master on the battlefield that is not Embarked. That Model is removed from play (it does not count as destroyed) and this Model is set up in its place, joining the same Unit if that Model had joined one. If no such Model is on the battlefield at the start of the fourth battle turn, this Model may instead be set up wholly within its Controlling Player's deployment zone at the start of that Movement Phase.

unitRules.name: The Last Laugh
unitRules.text: Once per battle, at the start of any Phase, this Model may be removed and set up again anywhere within 24" of where it was and more than 1" from all enemy Models. If it was Locked in Combat, it no longer is, and it may not be Charged in the same Phase. The god was never there.

unitRules.name: Master of the Revels
unitRules.text: While this Model is on the battlefield, its Controlling Player gains one additional Reaction Point in each enemy Player Turn.

units.note: Cegorach hides from Slaanesh and has never manifested; this is the Great Harlequin who plays him, taken over by the god for one performance. Written for this list.
units.name: Avatar of Cegorach
